verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents an official hosted remote MCP server that any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code) can connect to for documentation search, examples, and setup help. The probe confirms official MCP documentation, and the MCP plugin additionally lets apps act as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting to the server, connection setup details in the evidence, and tools beyond docs/setup help (e.g. operating on a project's auth instance).
